title: Chapter 58
text: Though gryphon riders are not capable of producing signets, they are not powerless. In fact, some would argue that they’ve honed lesser magic, especially mindwork, into the deadliest weapon of all. Underestimating them is an error. —G RYPHONS OF P OROMIEL , A S TUDY IN C OMBAT BY M AJOR G ARION S AVOY
